notes.title: On the Upcoming Release
notes.notes:
As we're approaching closer to release, which I hope will be in early 2025; I would like to thank the several testers who helped through development, and should put it out there that the test keys will have granted the full title as the test has come to an end.
In other news, CBS: the beginning will have new extra content already planned right before the first major patch. This includes game soundtrack and a dlc with level advancement and further story as part of the full game, which can be described as an expansion pack.
Again thank you to those who have helped and endured with especially me through the past several years, in making of the whole series to reach a conclusion.
